correctness.rationale: The 001-avoidance transfer matrices P=M(+), N=M(−) exactly give every character sum e∏M(ε_i)1 for linearly scanned words. Integer identities N³=I, P³≡I (mod 2), and B=P²N fixing terminal vector prove the zero modes for n mod3=1,2 and periodic witnesses of magnitudes δ_(n mod3)=1,2,4. The count F_(n+3)−1 is odd if n mod3=0, so then every multiplier is nonzero; modulo-four divisibility for n mod3=2 follows from even single-coordinate marginals (three exhaustive exponent residue pairs). Thus gcd, least nonzero magnitude, inverse norm and condition number hold for all n>=3; bounded Walsh checks only corroborate.
